_readme: THE DOSSIER — one source of truth for every application.
Every job, fellowship, grant and scholarship application asks the same
twenty things in slightly different boxes: a bio at three lengths, a
mission statement, the legal entity, the recognitions, the references.
Retyping them is where applying actually dies. This file holds the
answers once so an application is assembly, not composition.
RULE: nothing goes in here that is not verifiable. Fields marked TODO
are blank on purpose — an application is the last place to guess, and a
wrong identifier on a federal form is worse than a missing one.
Anything sensitive (EIN, UEI, CAGE, SAM registration) stays OUT of this
file. It ships with the public site. Those live in the private desk.

bios.fifty: Matthew McCluster is a Southern Connecticut State University Computer Science student and infrastructure, technical-operations and platform professional. He founded McCluster Corp and operates technology, civic, educational and creative projects including Equity Uprise and PRIM3, while developing connected-mobility work through Whip Equipped LLC.
bios.oneHundred: Matthew McCluster is a Southern Connecticut State University Computer Science student with professional experience across IT support, enterprise infrastructure, data centers, networks, systems, platform operations and connected mobility. He founded McCluster Corp, whose projects include Equity Uprise, PRIM3 and the Uprise Action Network, and founded Whip Equipped LLC, where his work spans telematics, vehicle systems and connected-mobility development. His work also includes photography, web design, media production, songwriting, public-policy research and civic technology. Public recognition in 2025 includes a Connecticut General Assembly citation and proclamations from the State of Georgia and City of Bridgeport.
